description_en: Prominent Minab lineage suffering 6+ casualties among elementary school children and adult parent rescuer.
Teacher-mother Neda Solhizadeh, father Hamid Sadeghi, and 11-year-old son Hami Sadeghi were martyred; survived by 10-year-old daughter Nila Sadeghi.
Pregnant teacher Zohreh Shahriyari and her 6-month unborn son Mohammad-Ali.
Two brothers (Ali-Akbar and Mohammad-Ali) and their rescuing father Ali Karyanipak.
Three sibling children (Athena, Amin, and Arad) and their father Hassan Ahmadzadeh.
Sister Asna and brother Mohammad-Hatam Raeisi, along with their father Hossein Raeisi.
Four children from the extended Bahrami household in Minab.
7-year-old active gymnast Makan Nasiri (Unmarked Martyr / شهید بی‌نشان).
Two children (Mohammad-Javad and Mehgol) pulled from rubble by mother Zahra Molaei; both survived with injuries.
